text: Trainer: This morning, seating plans needs a look before the shift ends. Coordinator: Please review the companion manifest and confirm each carrier is matched to the correct cabin note. Handler: Keep a calm tone at intake and move each crate with both hands, never rush the pet. Planner: <<FACT F017>> Dispatcher: Check ventilation, leash readiness, and the comfort item list before release. Trainer: If a traveler arrives anxious, speak plainly and keep the process steady. Coordinator: The Companion Animal Travel Desk should keep every handoff clear and respectful. Handler: Inspect seals, labels, and water access before the ground team moves the carrier. Planner: Record any temperament concern at once and pass it to the senior coordinator. Dispatcher: Aurelia Skyways expects dependable companion travel, so every step must be careful. Trainer: Use the same wording with all crews, and keep instructions concise. Coordinator: Confirm the final load is stable, and let the team know the pet is secure.
